description: Status: available once enabled by the operator; until then it answers withdrawal_unavailable (HTTP 503) and the withdrawal works by e-mail or letter as described in /legal/widerruf. Electronic withdrawal (Paragraph 356a BGB), two steps. Step 1: withdrawal = {order_id (ord_...) or order_number, buyer: {email, name (optional)}, statement (optional)} returns a summary with a request id (wrq_..., valid 30 min) and expires_at; nothing is declared and the shop is not contacted yet. Step 2, only after the buyer explicitly confirmed: withdrawal_id = wrq_... + confirm = true declares the withdrawal; the result carries the reference (wdr_...) and received_at (receipt confirmation), and the shop sends a confirmation of receipt by e-mail. Works even while ordering is paused (consumer right). meta.idempotency-key is required.

confirm.description: Step 2: true, only after the buyer explicitly confirmed.
